transcript.answer: No. Otto's spec (support-agent-tms-access, FR-031 and FR-034) says tool definitions registered in apps/api must not declare a customer id, company id or account number in their input schema. Issue #560 (T006) adds a guard in `apps/api/src/tools/registerTools.ts` that refuses any tool whose inputSchema declares such a field. The aim is to stop tools bypassing the customer scope resolver, which supplies the customer scope instead. A customer number there is rejected at registration. I read this from the issue and the spec references. I did not see the code itself.

judgements.reason: The answer says no and that registerTools refuses any tool whose input schema declares a customer id, company id or account number, which matches the gold's core claim; it omits the any-depth, Danish-spelling and test details but contradicts nothing.
